title: IntegrationAdapterResponse
description: Adapter -> daemon response envelope. MUST NOT carry ledger, idempotency, or side-effect-evidence state (those are daemon-owned, FR-003).

contractVersion.description: Must exactly match the daemon contract version.

failureKind.description: Present when status=failure; mapped to existing integration diagnostics / live-validation classification.

payload.description: Present when status=ok; normalized result mirroring existing snapshot/projection types.
